what: A change to a small crate (blaze-screen, 15 tests that run in five seconds) waits behind every other lane`s release build and ten-minute command: three were ahead, so one compile-and-test took the better part of the session`s end, and several commits were pushed without having been compiled.
cost: unverified commits on the branch until the queue reached it
cause: one lock for every lane and every kind of command
workaround: one job that runs every check, queued once
fix: a second, short queue for `cargo test -p <small crate>` of a branch in its own target directory
